blocks.text: 145 Musaph for the New Year 145
While the Kohanim make their way to the דוכן, the congregation say: ותערב

May our entreaty be pleasing to Thee like the whole-offering and the sacrifice. O Merciful One, restore Thy presence to Zion in Thy great mercies and the order of worship to Jerusalem. Let our eyes behold Thy return to Zion in compassion and let us serve Thee there in awe as in olden times and former years. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, whom alone we wish to worship in awe.
uncertainties: 'whole-offering' is broken at a line end but is a real compound word. 'pres-ence' is a line-break hyphen and was joined.
'Blessed art Thou…' starts a new paragraph after the cue word ברוך.

blocks.text: We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy sindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
uncertainties: 'sindnesses' is kept as printed. See source_sic_corr.

blocks.text: We thank Thee because Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of all flesh, our Creator, the Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanks to Thy Great and Holy Name for having kept us alive and let us survive. So mayest Thou further keep us alive and let us survive and gather our exiles to the court-yards of Thy Sanctuary in order to observe Thy statutes and do Thy will and serve Thee whole-heartedly; wherefore we thank Thee. Blessed be God to whom thanks are due.
uncertainties: 'Cre-ator', 'may-est' and 'Bless-ed' are line-break hyphens and were joined. 'court-yards' and 'whole-heartedly' fall mid-line, so their hyphens are real.
